title: Cyber Knight II: Chikyuu Teikoku no Yabou
description: A tactical RPG in a sci-fi setting filled with mechs and spaceships. The crew from the first game makes it back to Earth only to discover that a despotic empire has taken over. They must once again take to the stars to raise forces to thwart Earth's new dictators.
